svg.title: What the shopper does, and the event the SDK sends
svg.desc: What a shopper does on each page and the tracking event the SDK sends. Landing page: opens the page, page_viewed; sees a product, product_viewed; adds it to the cart, product_added_to_cart. Checkout page: opens the checkout, checkout_started; enters contact details, checkout_contact_info_submitted; enters a shipping address, checkout_shipping_address_submitted; gets a shipping method, checkout_shipping_method_submitted; submits the payment, checkout_payment_info_submitted; pays, checkout_completed. Upsell page: sees an offer, upsell_viewed; accepts it, upsell_completed; declines it, upsell_skipped.
